name: Compactness-Aware Frequency-Guided Densification (CAFe-GS)
definition: A compactness-aware densification strategy for 3D Gaussian Splatting that replaces the traditional positional-gradient threshold with a per-Gaussian error score modulated by local frequency cues to control the quality-compactness trade-off.
summary: CAFe-GS is a 3D Gaussian Splatting densification strategy that uses frequency-guided error scores to reduce redundant primitives and achieve higher compactness than gradient-based methods.
